decisions.reason: Every implementation packet now declares its shared integration paths separately from its exclusive contract paths and carries an explicit serialized no-weakening authority rule.

The PRD no longer claims a dependency edge to its slices, and the seed explicitly distinguishes the hierarchical Parent/Slices relationship from reciprocal Blocks/Blocked-by edges between implementation packets.

The seed now states the irreducible trust boundary: no Candidate artifact can prove maintainer identity; only the authenticated GitHub merge event supplies that identity and integration revision, and pre-merge state cannot exceed ready-for-human.

The checked-in projection record is explicitly non-authoritative. Fresh source-blind QA successfully reran all six network checks at this Candidate; a Hardener network outage cannot establish remote drift, and post-merge completion already requires a separate maintainer rerun and closeout.
